posts.content:
Antitrust Reforms for AI Safety

Frontier AI labs hesitate to collaborate on safety due to antitrust fears. Policymakers urged to amend frameworks for safe harbors.

Enables cross-lab coordination for AI risk mitigation

#AIGovernance #Alygn

AI Governance Arbitrage

Actors exploit gaps between international AI frameworks, risking fragmentation & race-to-bottom regulation.

UNU calls for interoperability via mutual recognition of standards

#AIGovernance #Alygn

Industry Influence in AI Regulation

Industry stakeholders increasingly shape AI rules. Experts push multi-stakeholder inclusion for balanced oversight.

Promoting diverse coordination to counter industry dominance

#AIGovernance #Alygn

Anthropic vs DoD Contract

Anthropic seeks to revise US DoD deal after being labeled supply-chain risk for rejecting surveillance clauses.

Sets precedents for ethical coordination & institutional guardrails

#AIGovernance #Alygn

OpenAI Safety Protocols

Sam Altman commits to stricter reporting & law enforcement ties post-incident, applying standards retroactively.

Exemplifies bilateral institutional coordination for safety

#AIGovernance #Alygn
